{
 "summary": "Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and adjusts build manifests to match newer upstream packages. It switches build scripts to CMake's native CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR flag, drops the custom osslsigncode definition in favor of upstream Guix, updates Python lief to 1.0.0 in CI lint and Guix, and disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc.",
 "problem": "The pinned Guix build environment lags behind upstream Guix package definitions, leaving newer compiler toolchains (such as GCC 16 and Clang 22/23) unavailable, using deprecated package module imports, and requiring temporary workarounds for packages like osslsigncode.",
 "card": "Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and updates package recipes across deterministic build manifests. It switches to CMake 4.3.3 and native CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR flags, drops a local osslsigncode override in favor of upstream Guix, updates lief to 1.0.0, and disables fixincludes on cross-gcc. This keeps release binaries reproducible on modern toolchains while making GCC 16 and Clang 22/23 available.",

 }
